classification.source: IMF World Economic Outlook, April 2026 Database Appendix

target_codelist.raw_source: IMF.STA:BOP(21.0.0) Portal dataflow structure response with references=all

Micronesia.basis: The WEO-to-IMF CL_AREA source row identifies Micronesia as area FM / Micronesia, Federated States of. Therefore the country-level BOP code FSM is selected; the same-name regional aggregate U057 is not used.

West Bank and Gaza.basis: Exact label in the Portal-owned CL_BOP_COUNTRY codelist. This is a dataset code mapping, not a geopolitical/legal-status assertion.

Namibia.basis: Direct exact match in the Portal-owned CL_BOP_COUNTRY codelist; no CL_AREA crosswalk code is required.

limits: This maps WEO EMDE membership names to BOP COUNTRY dimension codes only.
A mapped country code does not prove that the country reports usable observations for a given series or period.
No BOP observations were acquired by this crosswalk task.
Actual reporter coverage must be measured from the BOP data response, separately for assets/liabilities and frequency.
